body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type (run #17, re-verified); **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED)**.
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip**; hidden-valley breach notches preserve this.
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: `level == 1` gates must become "topmost level" if more levels land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: HandoffTicksToImpact = 22.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (run #50)**: below view PLUMB, dim 0.06, hairlines, reveal.
- **Mesa model rejected**; stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never the stale `def.graphic` field** (run-53; lore).
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred tab/expando switches, snapshot-gated rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.
- **Cross-level work migrates only for STRICTLY better-ranked work** (index in the pawn's own WorkGiversInOrderNormal); equal rank stays local (user-approved 2026-07-22). Async/actors/AOT explicitly rejected for job scanning — main-thread sim only.
- **CrossLevelDemand skips Blueprint_Install** (no material cost; asking logs a vanilla error — fixed + verified run #62).
- **TEXTURE POLICY (2026-07-22, user-directed)**: user supplies ALL stair/ladder/elevator art — agent must NOT regenerate it. Stairs/grand stairs/wide stairs/ladders rotatable (Graphic_Multi, `_north/_east/_south/_west`); elevator explicitly NOT rotatable (Graphic_Single). Risers ("conduits") have NO custom art: vanilla/host-mod linked atlases on the Conduits altitude layer.
- **Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only (2026-07-23, user-approved)**: installed animation framework mods (Yayo's, Melee Animation, NL FA, RJW frameworks) explicitly NOT used — native AnimationDef + BaseAnimationWorker composes with all of them and keeps the mod standalone.

## CLIMB/EMERGE ANIMATIONS + WIDE STAIRS (2026-07-23) — BUILT, awaiting in-game check
- **Climb animation** (Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs + Defs/Animations/AB_ClimbAnimations.xml): two AnimationDefs (`AB_Climb`, `AB_Emerge`) targeting the Root render-tree node with custom BaseAnimationWorkers. Workers are PURELY procedural: keyframe data ignored; all easing/duration comes from a per-pawn snapshot (`ABClimbState` in a ConcurrentDictionary — main-thread writes, render-worker-thread reads, per animation lore on parallel pre-draw).
- Visuals: step bob (|sin|, 12t period, 0.05 amp) + alternating ±3° lean for stairs; slower taller rung bob (16t, 0.08), no lean, for ladders (`ladder` flag added to ABStairsExtension, set on both ladder defs); smoothstep slide from the touch cell onto the stairwell center (capped 1.35 cells); progressive sink −0.35z + shrink ×0.72 going down, rise +0.30z + grow ×1.10 going up. Emerge: 22t ease-out-quad flourish on the arrival map — slides out of the stairwell, settling from raised+enlarged (arrived below) or sunken+shrunk (arrived above).
- Wiring: `AddPreInitAction`/`AddFinishAction` on the climb toils of JobDriver_UseStairs, JobDriver_HaulAcrossLevels, JobDriver_ABTakePawnAcrossLevels; `StartEmerge` in StairTransfer.Transfer (delta = sign of level change). Elevators + utilityOnly links excluded (ride, not climb). Multi-hop chains re-trigger per hop.
- Safety: never stomps a foreign CurAnimation (Anomaly lunges etc.); Stop() clears only our climb def and leaves emerge states for the janitor (job finish runs AFTER transfer already started the flourish); ABGameComp tick janitor clears finished emerges (no-op when list empty); climb visuals auto-hide 60t past expected duration (stalled job never leaves a sunk pawn); everything gated by ABGuard.Rendering + `climbAnimations` toggle (default on, view tab, reset+scribe+keyed).
- **Wide stairs**: `AB_WideStairsDown/Up`, 2x1 footprint, rotatable Graphic_Multi REUSING the normal stairs' user art at drawSize (2,1) (stretched 2:1, user-directed — no new asset slots, uiIcon shared with normal stairs). climbFactor 0.8, 150 stuff, 6400 work, mass 70, no quality comp — mid-tier between normal (1.0) and grand (0.6). Counterpart spawn + placeworker already use GenAdj.OccupiedRect, multi-cell safe (grand 2x2 precedent).

## TEXTURE / ROTATION REWORK (2026-07-22) — BUILT, awaiting user art + in-game check
- AB_StairsBase rotatable=true; AB_Elevator overrides back to false. Counterpart spawn already copies Rotation, so pairs stay aligned across levels.
- Stairs/grand stairs switched to Graphic_Multi with clean base paths (`Things/Building/AB_StairsDown` etc.); old doubled-name PNGs and all custom riser PNGs deleted (duct menu icons kept). Elevator texPath simplified to `Things/Building/AB_Elevator`. Modmixer stubs cover missing rotation files until the user drops art.
- Riser graphics: power conduit -> vanilla `Linked/PowerConduit_Atlas` (Transmitter linkType + PowerConduit linkFlags, vanilla menu icon, uiIconScale 0.7, shared in AB_VerticalConduitBase); DBH water riser -> `DBH/Things/Building/SewagePipe_Atlas` (Basic/Custom5, `DBH/UI/Plumbing` icon); VCHE riser -> `Things/Building/Linked/ChemfuelPipes_Atlas` (Basic/Custom7, VCHE menu icon); Rimefeller riser -> `Rimefeller/Things/Building/oilPipe_Atlas` (Basic/Custom6, `Rimefeller/UI/Plumbing` icon); VEF generic duct -> VEF `Special/PSTransmitterAtlas` (Basic, linkFlags None — bridges every PipeSystem net so it welds to none; keeps AB duct icons for distinct up/down build buttons). AB_VerticalLinkBase altitudeLayer Building -> Conduits.
- **WATCH AT NEXT SYNC**: patches now reference FOREIGN texPaths (DBH/, Rimefeller/, Special/, VCHE's Linked/). If the asset scanner writes magenta stubs for these it would SHADOW the host mods' textures — check sync drift warnings and delete any such stubs immediately.

## MECH ESCORT CROSS-LEVEL FOLLOW — BUILT 2026-07-22, awaiting in-game check
User repro: drafted mechanitor descends to basement -> escort-mode mechs fall to wander ("Patrolling"). Root cause: vanilla escort branch nulls out top-to-bottom when the overseer holds a different map (AIFollowOverseer dies on cross-map CanReach; WanderOverseer bails on Map != pawn.Map; ExitMapFollowOverseer is caravan-only), so the tree falls through to idle wander. Fix: **Patch_MechEscortFollow_CrossLevel** (Movement/MechEscortAcrossLevels.cs) — postfix `JobGiver_AIFollowOverseer.TryGiveJob`: null result + overseer on a linked same-column level -> destination-aware stairs job toward the overseer's level (dest = overseer position on direct link); arrival re-runs the escort branch (normal follow when local; two-hop chains). Think node already gates to Escort work mode. Guards: ABGuard.Movement + crossLevelOrders toggle, no lord, 250t ABPawnCooldown charged before the stair scan. Complements existing Patch_MechCommandRange_CrossLevel (command cylinder for drafted mech orders).

## PRIORITY-AWARE CROSS-LEVEL WORK — USER-VERIFIED run #62 (both directions: surface->basement warden case, sky->surface construction case)
Two tiers in Patch_JobGiverWork_CrossLevel:
- **Tier 1 (idle)**: unchanged — empty local scan probes linked levels (+ separate emergency path, + idle return home).
- **Tier 2 (priority-aware, toggle `priorityCrossLevelWork` nested under crossLevelWork)**: local job found -> recover its giver's index via `Job.workGiverDef` in the pawn's `WorkGiversInOrderNormal` (encodes manual priorities AND natural order; works in checkbox mode). If any strictly-earlier giver could have work on a linked level, run a TRUNCATED virtual-position probe (stop at local rank), take stairs on a hit. Non-scan local jobs (no workGiverDef stamp) never yield. Emergency-pass results always stand. Direct links only; two-hop resolves by chaining.
Perf architecture: gate chain cheapest-first; **LevelWorkSummary** per-map bool[] by WorkTypeDef.index, TTL 600, real detectors for ~17 vanilla work types, uncovered types FAIL OPEN; **event-driven invalidation** (DesignationManager.AddDesignation postfix bumps global WorkVersion + drops map entry); **VersionedCooldown** (900t) stores charge-time version so fresh designations bypass all cooldowns O(1); **global probe budget** 2/tick; probe skips AB-namespace givers (no recursion), caps cell-scanners at 300 cells, existence-only scans. Migration charges the shared 1200t cooldown against ping-pong.

## MISC. ROBOTS COMPAT — USER-VERIFIED run #62 (bot hauls below, low battery routes home + docks)
Root cause was: robots' custom X2_JobGiver_Work enumerates WorkGiverDefs by work type -> picks up our cross-level haul givers and descends; but ALL their return/recharge givers resolve the bound station via CanReserveAndReach (map-scoped) -> null forever -> battery bricks. Fix (ABMiscRobotsCompat, by-name, fails open, covers Robots++):
- Postfix TryGiveJob on the 5 AIRobot return/recharge givers (DeclaredMethod only): null result + bound station on a linked level -> destination-aware stairs job toward the station level; arrival re-fires their giver (chains 2-hop). 450t per-robot cooldown.
- **LowPowerWorker guard** in both cross-level haul givers: non-humanlike with rest <45% or mech energy <35% never shipped out (also covers Biotech mechs).
- Stairs/elevator float menu opened to player-faction ToolUser pawns (CanBeOrderedToUse).

## SETTINGS + GEN-CONTROL SUITE (2026-07-22) — BUILT, awaiting in-game check
Five tabs, per-tab measured scrolls + resets, presets, reset-all confirm, ABGuard status panel with Re-arm. Generation knobs (plateau openness, meadow size, edge bands, outcrops, tarns, hidden valleys, soil, veg, ore, caverns; presets Default/Dramatic/Subtle/Lush) + seeded live preview panel (ABTrueColors, debounced rebuilds, re-roll). Sky landmarks: Odyssey Mutator* GenSteps on AB_Sky; per-landmark 4-state ladder, master toggle+chance+cap, aquatic/cave defaults Disabled, VLE via DefDatabase, defName-dict scribe, Odyssey-gated. New priority-work checkbox verified rendering run #62. NEW: climbAnimations checkbox on the view tab.

## Below-view rendering (USER-VERIFIED)
Pure altitude transform; ScreenToBelowPos identity; mask dim 0.06; hairline skirt; wall-top reveal; multi-cell below-print anchor = first air cell; shrink exempts linked + rock/ores by def.

## COMPAT (ALL USER-VERIFIED): sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode. Probe reports fill branch/material/queues.

## PARITY TRANCHE — COMPLETE (#1-#15); pod transit + AA verified #39.
## 2026-07-21 TRANCHE: stair routing (self-test green), BC caverns (Earthen 55C), naturalistic peaks (verified #47), camera level lock (End).

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; combat/auto-engage/targeting-hub/animal-wander/ritual-attendance/mech-overseer/bond+home/pod-transit/stair-routing/cavern-basement/peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; toggle cap corner fillers.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains (verified). Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). **Misc. Robots + Robots++ (USER-VERIFIED 2026-07-22)**. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope. Climb animations use the native render-tree pipeline — composes with Yayo's/Melee Animation/facial mods, no dependency.

## Status
2026-07-23: climb/emerge animations + wide 2x1 stairs BUILT (compile green), awaiting in-game check. 2026-07-22 run #62: priority-aware work, Misc. Robots routing, LowPowerWorker guard, Blueprint_Install fix all USER-VERIFIED. Also outstanding: mech escort follow test, texture/rotation in-game check (awaiting user stair/ladder art; magenta stubs interim), settings preview responsiveness pass, landmark list UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen run, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep. Save points through `pre-settings-rework`.
